principle: Every outbound channel starts from evidence, not a static topic calendar, and writes outcome learning back to the exact source lineage.

linkedin_personal.selection: public evidence may select the theme; first-person claims require verified Arthur truth

linkedin_company.selection: rank concrete CEO/MT problems by freshness, evidence, business impact, recurrence and Powerhouse fit

blog.selection: prefer evidence-backed problem plus search/commercial intent; improve an owned page before creating cannibalizing content

email.selection: only contact when the evidence is relevant to the recipient/company and suppression/consent/quality gates pass

linkedin_dm.selection: same account-level evidence discipline as email; use a human-relevant micro-CTA and preserve provider/auth boundaries

instagram_company.selection: fresh public human-problem evidence outranks static seeds

fallback_rule: Static calendars are fallback only when no fresh eligible source-backed candidate exists.
cross_channel_rule: One source can create channel-specific candidates, but copy and CTA must be native to each channel; never copy-paste the same post across channels.
learning_rule: Outcome learning updates source quality, problem priority, message angle, CTA, channel fit and next-best action.
